definitions: A narrow, self-proclaimed republic in Eastern Europe, located mostly on a strip of land between the the Dniester River and the border with Ukraine.
An unrecognized breakaway state that is internationally recognized as part of Moldova.
examples: The political status of Transnistria is a complex issue.
Transnistria has its own government and currency.
Many international organizations do not recognize Transnistria as an independent state.
